channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Parcel K North (PKN)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcel K North (PKN) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel K North (PKN): The Sept 2017 Port memo's marketing and offer steps are now described as a plan (the sale closed in February 2019); the Port's '2020-2021 design and permitting' entry is described as a schedule line; and the Resolution 17-52 milestone no longer says it established a subdivided site (it records the Port's intent to subdivide). The Nov 2025 Potrero View milestone was removed because that article concerns Brookfield's site and does not mention Parcel K North, and the summary no longer says the parcel is unbuilt 'as of 2026' without a current source. The $24.2M use is stated as the memo says (reimbursing the developer's entitlement costs); the map notes cite the Port, TMG, Presidio Bay and Handel pages for units, size and developer, and no longer say the block has no Assessor lot; the 55-67 ft right-of-way range is noted as not applying to Michigan Street; the D4D plaza figure no longer credits private firms without a credit on the figure; and the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission minutes now back the informational hearing.
item.description: The Sept 2017 Port memo's marketing and offer steps are now described as a plan (the sale closed in February 2019); the Port's '2020-2021 design and permitting' entry is described as a schedule line; and the Resolution 17-52 milestone no longer says it established a subdivided site (it records the Port's intent to subdivide). The Nov 2025 Potrero View milestone was removed because that article concerns Brookfield's site and does not mention Parcel K North, and the summary no longer says the parcel is unbuilt 'as of 2026' without a current source. The $24.2M use is stated as the memo says (reimbursing the developer's entitlement costs); the map notes cite the Port, TMG, Presidio Bay and Handel pages for units, size and developer, and no longer say the block has no Assessor lot; the 55-67 ft right-of-way range is noted as not applying to Michigan Street; the D4D plaza figure no longer credits private firms without a credit on the figure; and the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission minutes now back the informational hearing. Source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Parcel K North project page (https://www.sfport.com/projects-programs/pier-70-parcel-k-north); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); TMG Partners, Pier 70 Parcel K North (https://www.tmgpartners.com/portfolio/pier-70-parcel-k-north-managed-pkn-manager-llc); The Potrero View, 2025-11 (https://www.potreroview.net/housing-at-pier-70-yet-to-materialize/) (does not state this); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2026-08-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11558/download?inline).
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Parcel K North project page (https://www.sfport.com/projects-programs/pier-70-parcel-k-north); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); TMG Partners, Pier 70 Parcel K North (https://www.tmgpartners.com/portfolio/pier-70-parcel-k-north-managed-pkn-manager-llc); The Potrero View, 2025-11 (https://www.potreroview.net/housing-at-pier-70-yet-to-materialize/) (does not state this); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2026-08-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11558/download?inline)

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel K North (PKN): The same Hoedown Yard CFD estimate moved off Hoedown Yard (HDY1/2) to the shared site-wide cost list was also moved off Parcel K North. Parcel K North's own $24.2M land-sale-proceeds figure (Port Item 11A, Aug 2026: '$24.2 million of land proceeds from the sale of Parcel K North in February 2019') stays on the record as a land/lease figure for this parcel.

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Parcel K North (PKN): Port Commission Resolution 17-52 approves the terms of the Port's sale of Parcel K North and a form of Vertical DDA, and records the Port's intent to merge and then subdivide the parcel into four new parcels (it does not itself subdivide anything); this transaction is separate from FC Pier 70's 28-Acre Project DDA, and the parcel's Feb 2019 sale to TMG Partners/Presidio Bay Ventures is a later ownership change, not the point it entered the plan (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission Resolution 17-52 approves the terms of the Port's sale of Parcel K North and a form of Vertical DDA, and records the Port's intent to merge and then subdivide the parcel into four new parcels (it does not itself subdivide anything); this transaction is separate from FC Pier 70's 28-Acre Project DDA, and the parcel's Feb 2019 sale to TMG Partners/Presidio Bay Ventures is a later ownership change, not the point it entered the plan (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel K North (PKN): Port's Sept 2017 disposition plan for Parcel K North: Colliers International to market the parcel (0.5% commission), with initial offers due November 2017, a short list by December 2017 and best-and-final offers by January 2018, and Cushman & Wakefield to appraise it for the City's Real Estate Division (a plan; the memo does not show these steps happened, and the sale closed in February 2019) (~2017)
